facts.fact: CBL Directive 002/2025 applies to all licensed Mobile Money Providers and threatens sanctions up to licence revocation under the New Payment Systems Law 2014 and Mobile Money Regulations 2014.

The Central Bank of Liberia directs that Government of Liberia mobile money payments and revenue collections be routed exclusively through NEPS/IIPS, with settlement at the CBL and monitoring of implementation by the CBL.

systems.system: NEPS/IIPS (National Electronic Payment Switch / Inclusive Instant Payment System)

LBR.note: No consumer-protection rule or redress stated.

facts.fact: CBL Directive 002/2025 says that from 27 October 2025 all Government of Liberia payments to beneficiaries by mobile money must be routed exclusively through NEPS/IIPS.
The directive names salaries, pensions, social benefits and other transfers as the government payments by mobile money routed through NEPS/IIPS.
The directive applies to licensed Mobile Money Providers in Liberia, which process government payment and collection transactions by mobile money.

CBL Directive 002/2025 says that from 1 December 2025 all Government of Liberia revenue collections by mobile money, including taxes, fees and levies, must be routed through NEPS/IIPS and settled into the consolidated Revenue Accounts at the CBL.
